auth_details: Application registration and approval required at boardgamegeek.com/applications; approved apps create tokens used as Authorization: Bearer <token> on all XML API requests.
resolution_notes: auth: auditor correct. Official guide (https://boardgamegeek.com/using_the_xml_api) states registration/authorization is required for the XML API; approved apps issue tokens sent as Authorization: Bearer. Wiki (https://boardgamegeek.com/wiki/page/BGG_XML_API2) points readers there and notes www can break auth. Community confirms enforcement live since ~Oct 2025. example: auditor correct for same reason—Bearer header is required; prior unauthenticated curl is outdated.
